item.title: Easy Sticky Buns
item.description: These easy sticky buns are a shortcut recipe that uses puff pastry rather than a dough to create a wonderful treat. The rolled puff pastry is filled with butter, brown sugar, ground cinnamon, and raisins. You can taste the warm cinnamon spice, which is a nice contrast to the sweet pops of raisins. On top is a gooey and sweet topping. The crunchy pecans caramelize in the brown sugar and butter mixture. This is a simple sticky bun recipe that can be whipped up quickly in the morning.

item.title: Fancy Reuben Loaf
item.description: Enjoy this Reuben loaf as an easy meal or appetizer. It's layered with corned beef, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese, and Thousand Island dressing. All the elements of a Reuben sandwich are stuffed inside buttery crescent dough. Super filling, this looks hard to make, but it's very simple. Perfect for a quick dinner or make a few for a game-time snack during football season.

item.title: Naughty Cheesecake Bars
item.description: Adding a few extra ingredients turns these cheesecake bars into naughty cheesecake bars. Chocolate chip cookie dough is baked to form a cookie crust. On top is a layer of chocolate sandwich cookies and a creamy, tangy, and sweet cheesecake layer. Then they're sprinkled with crushed chocolate sandwich cookies and milk chocolate malt candies. The combination of chocolate, malt, chocolate chip cookie, and cheesecake creates a naughty and indulgent dessert.

item.title: Creamy Chicken Tortilla Soup
item.description: The aroma of this chicken soup while cooking makes you practically giddy to fill up your bowl and give it a try! It's creamy and filled with Southwest flavor. Easy to make, this is guaranteed to warm ya up on a cold night.

item.title: Rum Glazed Pound Cake
item.description: This rum glazed pound cake is anything but basic. The cake is buttery, rich, and tender. Adding cream cheese helps keep it moist. The glaze on the top is boozy, buttery, and rich. It's on the thinner side, but the flavors from the caramel frosting and rum soak beautifully into the cake.

item.title: Cabbage and Beef Casserole
item.description: Try this comforting cabbage and beef casserole when you need an easy dinner on a cold day. Cooking the cabbage in beef broth adds a rich, savory flavor to the cabbage. The ground beef mixture is seasoned with onion soup mix, oregano, and garlic powder for a ton of flavor. Mixed with the cooked rice, tomatoes, tomato sauce, and tomato soup, it creates a hearty filling. Layered with the cooked, shredded cabbage, it's a great casserole dinner. item.title: Outback Steakhouse Alice Springs Chicken
item.description: When you can't go out to dinner, this recipe lets you recreate the steakhouse favorite at home. The homemade honey mustard makes this dish unique and delicious. Sweet and slightly tangy, its flavor soaks into the chicken breasts. Browning the chicken in bacon grease also adds a smoky flavor. Then it's topped with mushrooms, crumbled bacon, and a lot of cheese. Serve with a baked potato for a yummy meal. You'll have a lot of honey mustard left over that can be used for dipping.

item.title: Crock Pot Chicken and Dumplings
item.description: Preparing chicken and dumplings has never been easier. It's as simple as prepping the veggies, putting the ingredients into the slow cooker, and then letting the Crock Pot go to work. A short time before it's time to eat, shred the chicken and add the dumplings. The little pieces of dough puff into soft buttery pillows. The savory and lightly sweet sauce from the chicken soaks into the dumplings. A comforting meal the whole family will love.

item.title: Chocolate Pie With Peanut Butter Crust
item.description: One bite of this chocolate pie with a peanut butter crust and you'll think you're eating one of those famous Girl Scout cookies. It's a super-easy recipe that's perfect for kids to jump in on and lend a hand. Even though the Rice Krispies are crushed in the prep, you still get their crunch in each bite. Slices of the pie aren't the easiest to cut or the prettiest, but they're quite tasty.

item.title: Creamy Crock Pot Chicken With Pasta
item.description: If you need a quick-to-prep dinner recipe, try this creamy Crock Pot chicken with pasta. As long as chicken breasts are in the freezer, this recipe can be made with what's available in most kitchens. Combining cream of chicken soup, cream cheese, and butter creates a creamy and rich sauce. A packet of Italian seasoning adds a zesty zing. We served this chicken dinner over fettuccine pasta, but use your favorite or what's handy.
